Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Hardened Multi-Layer Player Popup & In-Page-Push Ad Blocker:
   - Blocks Adsterra Social Bar, ExoClick In-Page Push, Monetag, Galaksion, AdCash,
     AdSpyglass, Clickadu, HilltopAds, and adult fake-notification floating banners
     at both the WebView network layer (50+ expanded ad/IPP CDN domains) and the
     document-start cosmetic layer.
   - Hooks Element.prototype.attachShadow at document-start so open and closed
     Shadow DOM ad widgets are hidden along with their outer host container.
   - Eliminates floating Ad/Sponsored banners with SVG/CSS close icons, neutralizes
     window.open and invisible click-hijack overlays, and hides cross-origin ad
     banner iframes while keeping video, subtitles, controls, and Cloudflare
     verification untouched.

2. Android 15 (targetSdk 35) Edge-to-Edge Status Bar & Gesture Bar Window Fix:
   - Applies native WindowInsetsCompat (systemBars | displayCutout | ime) padding
     to MainActivity and KuroOfflineActivity561 when not in fullscreen/PiP, so the
     top Kuro header never overlaps the system clock, network speed, Bluetooth,
     5G, or battery icons, and switches cleanly to true edge-to-edge in fullscreen.

3. Unified Account, Trackers & Discord Rich Presence Hub (Proposal #3):
   - Kuro Cloud Account card, AniList 2-Way Sync, MyAnimeList Sync, Discord Rich
     Presence card, and granular sync toggles.

4. 24 Real Manga Face PFPs & Matching 16:9 Banners (art-11 .. art-34):
   - Replaced all legacy art-01..10 overlays with 24 authentic manga/manhwa face
     PFPs and matching 16:9 banners + one-tap "Match banner" pairing.

5. Desktop Leanback Left-Rail UI (Desktop Site Mode Only) & UI Cleanups:
   - Activates only when Settings -> Site view -> Desktop is enabled.
   - Hidden "Verify Library 11", "Surprise Me", and "Source sites · open separately".
